named-query.name: Action.findByUser
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Action a LEFT JOIN FETCH a.user WHERE a.user = :user ORDER BY a.date DESC

named-query.name: Action.countByUser
named-query.query: SELECT count(a) FROM Action a WHERE a.user = :user

named-query.name: Action.findAll
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Action a ORDER BY a.date DESC

named-query.name: Action.countAll
named-query.query: SELECT count(a) FROM Action a

named-query.name: Bookmark.findByUrl
named-query.query: SELECT b FROM Bookmark b WHERE b.url = :url

named-query.name: Curriculum.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Curriculum c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.education LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobExperiences LEFT JOIN FETCH c.languages LEFT JOIN FETCH c.skills WHERE c.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: Curriculum.Skill.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM Skill s WHERE s.name = :name

named-query.name: DocumentTemplate.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT d FROM DocumentTemplate d WHERE d.name = :name

named-query.name: DocumentTemplate.findByNameAndLanguage
named-query.query: SELECT d FROM DocumentTemplate d WHERE d.name = :name AND d.language = :language

named-query.name: JobSubmissionEvent.findAllByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobSubmissionEvent j WHERE j.jobSubmission.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobSubmissionEvent.countAllByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobSubmissionEvent j WHERE j.jobSubmission.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobSubmission.countApprovedByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobSubmission j LEFT JOIN j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer AND j.state.approved = TRUE

named-query.name: JobSubmission.findByJobOfferAndCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobSubmission j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer AND j.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobSubmission.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobSubmission j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer.client LEFT JOIN FETCH j.state WHERE j.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobSubmission.countByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobSubmission j WHERE j.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobSubmission.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobSubmission j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobSubmission.countByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobSubmission j WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobSubmission.findByUser
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobSubmission j WHERE :user MEMBER OF j.jobOffer.recruiters OR j.jobOffer.owner = :user

named-query.name: JobOffer.findRecruitersByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE :jobOffer MEMBER OF u.recruiterOfJobOffers

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOfferData
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.recruiters LEFT JOIN FETCH j.client LEFT JOIN FETCH j.owner WHERE j.id = :id

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOffersToOpen
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.openDate <= CURRENT_DATE AND j.state = :state

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOffersToClose
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.closeDate > CURRENT_DATE

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOffersByOwnerOrRecruiter
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.client LEFT JOIN FETCH j.owner WHERE :user MEMBER OF j.recruiters OR j.owner = :user

named-query.name: JobOffer.countJobOffersByOwnerOrRecruiter
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobOffer j WHERE :user MEMBER OF j.recruiters OR j.owner = :user

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j INNER JOIN j.jobSubmissions jc WHERE jc.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOfferProcess
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOfferProcess j

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByClient
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.owner LEFT JOIN FETCH j.client WHERE j.client = :client

named-query.name: JobOffer.countByClient
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.client = :client

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOfferEventsByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOfferEvent j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer.client LEFT JOIN FETCH j.user WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobOffer.countJobOfferEventsByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobOfferEvent j WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobOfferProcess.findJobOfferProcessByName
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOfferProcess j WHERE j.name = :name

named-query.name: Meeting.findPlannedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned >= current_date ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC

named-query.name: Meeting.findMonthdMeetingsByUser
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.datePlanned >= :startDate AND m.datePlanned <= :endDate AND :email MEMBER OF m.attendeesEmails ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC

named-query.name: Meeting.countPlannedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(m) FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned >= current_date

named-query.name: Meeting.findConductedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned < current_date ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC

named-query.name: Meeting.countConductedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(m) FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned < current_date

named-query.name: Meeting.findByAttendeesEmail
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.datePlanned >= current_date AND :email MEMBER OF m.attendeesEmails ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC
